basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 29-year-old from Austin, Texas. Currently working as a graphic designer for a small creative agency. I've been a fan of life simulation games since Harvest Moon on the SNES, and now I enjoy playing Stardew Valley during my downtime. I love discussing game strategies and sharing tips with others. In my free time, I also dabble in video editing using Hitfilm and occasionally explore new gadgets like the Playdate Console. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 6-10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the industry for over 5 years. I picked up video editing through online tutorials and forums, and I've been experimenting with various software tools, including Hitfilm. My knowledge of life simulation games is mostly self-taught, accumulated through years of passionate gaming.
